title: Sriram Dang v. State of U.P. & Ors.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashok Bhushan, J.; Sunita Agarwal, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner may apply afresh under clause 4.4.
headnote: Mandamus to decide a representation for a fresh electricity connection after a landlord-dispute disconnection was refused on the merits. The petitioner had not completed an application for a new connection. The Court left it open to apply afresh; the licensee may consider that application in accordance with clause 4.4 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Sriram Dang sought a mandamus directing the electricity authorities to decide his representation dated 12 January 2012. He asked for a fresh electricity connection after supply had been disconnected because of a dispute with his landlord. Counsel for the distribution licensee submitted that the petitioner had not made any application for a fresh connection after completing the prescribed formalities, and that no connection had therefore been released.

holding_units.holding: Where a person seeks a fresh electricity connection after disconnection arising from a landlord dispute, and no completed application has been submitted, it is open to him to apply afresh; the licensee may consider that application in accordance with clause 4.4 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. A writ to decide an earlier representation is disposed of on that footing without directing a connection.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner was entitled to a fresh connection on the representation dated 12.1.2012 without a completed application under clause 4.4
Merits of the disconnection arising from the landlord dispute
